title: Independent electronic-structure investigation of DQCS divalent-metal complexes
difficulty_reasons: The systems are fixed but the agent must formulate and justify its own computational model and discriminate a metal-dependent electronic-structure explanation without a supplied author route.

paper.title: Unveiling multi-responsive colorimetric and fluorescent sensing behavior and DFT insights of a novel coumarin and 8-hydroxyquinoline conjugate for Cd2+, Co2+, and Ni2+ ions detection

data.description: Three complete 65-center XYZ coordinate files for named DQCS+Cd2+, DQCS+Co2+, and DQCS+Ni2+ complexes; each declares +2 singlet state.

required_deliverables.description: Independent validated per-complex electronic observables, comparison, and limitations.
